Is the mandible still attached to the maxilla?
Are further adjustments to the segmentation plane required?
Are further adjustments to the boundary planes required?
Are further adjustments to the implant paths required?

cb_step_1.title: Choose the source volume
cb_step_1.instruction: Select the volume to use for segmentation.

cb_step_2.title: Create a new segmentation
cb_step_2.instruction: In the Segment Editor module, create a new segmentation named Cranial_Segmentation.

cb_step_3.title: Add a segment
cb_step_3.instruction: Click Add, then rename the segment to Cranial_Segment.

cb_step_4.title: Open Threshold effect
cb_step_4.instruction: In the Segment Editor module, click the Threshold button.

cb_step_5.title: Set threshold range
cb_step_5.instruction: Adjust the threshold range to select the desired intensity values.

cb_step_6.title: Apply threshold
cb_step_6.instruction: Click Apply to create the segmented region.

cb_step_7.title: Choose the skull segment
cb_step_7.instruction: In the Skull segmentation section, choose the skull segmentation segment.

cb_step_8.title: Choose entry point list
cb_step_8.instruction: In the Entry points section, choose the point list node to use for entry points.

cb_step_9.title: Compute symmetry plane
cb_step_9.instruction: Click the "1. Compute symmetry plane" button.

cb_step_10.title: Adjust symmetry plane?
cb_step_10.instruction: Choose whether to manually adjust the symmetry plane. If not needed, continue.

cb_step_11.title: Adjust symmetry plane
cb_step_11.instruction: Position the symmetry plane in the view, then click Done.

cb_step_13.title: Set crop radius
cb_step_13.instruction: Adjust the range bar to set the crop radius in mm.

cb_step_15.title: Mandible still attached?
cb_step_15.instruction: Choose whether the mandible is still attached to the maxilla. If it is separated, continue.

cb_step_16.title: Separate maxilla / mandible
cb_step_16.instruction: Click the "3. Separate maxilla / mandible" button.

cb_step_17.title: Adjust separation plane?
cb_step_17.instruction: Choose whether to manually adjust the segmentation plane. If not needed, continue.

cb_step_18.title: Adjust separation plane
cb_step_18.instruction: Position the separation plane in the view, then click Done.

cb_step_20.title: Identify zygomatic bones
cb_step_20.instruction: Click the "4. Identify zygomatic bones" button.

cb_step_21.title: Adjust boundary planes?
cb_step_21.instruction: Choose whether to manually adjust the boundary planes. If not needed, continue.

cb_step_22.title: Adjust boundary plane
cb_step_22.instruction: Position one boundary plane in the view, then click Done.

cb_step_24.title: Generate implant paths
cb_step_24.instruction: Click the "5. Generate Implant paths" button.

cb_step_25.title: Adjust implant paths?
cb_step_25.instruction: Choose whether to manually adjust the implant paths. If not needed, stop here.

cb_step_26.title: Adjust implant path
cb_step_26.instruction: Place one implant path in the view, then click Done.
